blocks.x: At industry level, the same pattern

At Logistics & Supply Chain level this capability reads as: telematics, door and temperature telemetry with governance (cold-chain and detention visible live). The sub-industry page narrows it to the unit's workflows, regimes and KPIs.

The cadence below is the standard pattern for this capability, and it does not flex by account. Weeks 1–2 lock the baseline: the current metric is measured with your team and signed before build starts. Weeks 3–8 deliver the pilot on bounded scope — one decision path, one workflow, one plant or one portfolio — with a control owner named on your side. Weeks 9–12 industrialize what worked: runbooks, monitoring, enablement and a measured delta against the signed baseline. Anything that misses its gate is stopped or redirected with a documented decision, not quietly extended.
